goals.objective: Resolve GitHub #20 for agentdir: complete cross-platform release QA coverage work with TDD RED->GREEN evidence, manual CLI QA artifacts, commit cleanly, open/update PR targeting dev, peer-review, and merge to dev if all verification passes.

successCriteria.scenario: tmux: run git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/codex/cross-platform-release-qa origin/dev, gh pr checks 20 --watch=false, and gh pr view 20 --json baseRefName,headRefName,state,reviewDecision,mergeStateStatus,statusCheckRollup,url; PASS iff ancestry exits 0, checks are all pass, and PR #20 state is documented.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/pr-20-dev-ancestry-and-checks.txt plus existing RED evidence .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/pr-20-readiness-red.txt and GREEN issue_18_release_qa output
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/pr-20-dev-ancestry-and-checks.txt: ancestry exit 0; diff vs dev empty; gh pr checks 20 reported 12 successful; PR state documented as open/main/review-required. RED: pr-20-readiness-red.txt; GREEN: issue_18_release_qa.py 10 PASS. cleanup: killed tmux session ulw-qa-pr20-state; no session remains

successCriteria.scenario: tmux: run python3 scripts/ci/release_preflight.py --expected-version 0.0.0 and python3 scripts/ci/release_preflight.py --expected-version 0.1.5; PASS iff mismatch exits nonzero with version mismatch and correct expected version exits 0.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/pr-20-release-preflight-rerun.txt: --expected-version 0.0.0 exited 1 with version mismatch; --expected-version 0.1.5 exited 0. RED: pr-20-readiness-red.txt and pr-20-python-wheel-entrypoint-red.txt. cleanup: killed tmux session ulw-qa-pr20-preflight; no session remains

successCriteria.scenario: tmux: build agentdir CLI, run python3 scripts/ci/cli_smoke.py --agentdir target/debug/agentdir --keep-temp and python3 scripts/ci/strategy_smoke.py --agentdir target/debug/agentdir --keep-temp; PASS iff both exit 0, expected pass lines are present, retained temp dirs are removed, and no ulw-qa-pr20 tmux sessions remain.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/pr-20-cli-strategy-rerun.txt plus existing RED evidence .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/pr-20-ci-enforcement-red.txt and existing manual QA evidence pr-20-cli-keep-temp.txt/pr-20-strategy-keep-temp.txt
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/pr-20-cli-strategy-rerun.txt: cargo build -p agentdir-cli exit 0; CLI smoke passed; reflink/virtual/symlink strategy passed; Strategy smoke passed. RED: pr-20-ci-enforcement-red.txt. cleanup: killed tmux session ulw-qa-pr20-cli-strategy; removed retained temp dirs; no session remains
